# envoy-go Roadmap

## Schema

Phases are tracked as rows in the tables below. Columns:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Phase identifier (e.g. `00`, `04`, `04.1`). Sub-phases use a decimal suffix (see §6 of `BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md`). |
| `title` | Short human-readable title matching the phase directory slug under `docs/envoy-go/phases/`. |
| `depends-on` | Comma-separated list of phase ids that must be `done` before this phase can enter `in-progress`. Empty for the first phase. |
| `status` | One of `planned`, `in-progress`, `blocked`, `done`. |
| `sub-phases` | If the phase was split (see §6), this lists the sub-phase ids (e.g. `04.1, 04.2`). Empty otherwise. |
| `summary` | One-line summary of the phase's differential surface at completion. |

### Invariants

- **Append-only history.** Rows are never deleted. Only `status` and `sub-phases` columns are updated in place. Sub-phases get their own rows.
- **Status transitions.** `planned` → `in-progress` → (`blocked` or `done`). `blocked` is an exit state only when an upstream dependency is unavailable; the phase resumes on the same row when unblocked.
- **Sub-phase rows.** When a parent phase is split, the parent stays `in-progress` with `sub-phases` listing children; each child gets its own row whose `depends-on` references the prior child (so children execute in order unless stated otherwise).
- **Families (§9 headings) are not rows.** Each heading is expanded into per-phase rows when a phase under that family enters `in-progress`. Do not pre-populate rows for unbrainstormed phases.

---

Mechanism: `internal/filter/hcm/h2/stream.go` builds TWO things and both mishandle `host` — `buildH2Request` fills `Authority` from `:authority` ONLY and its `default:` arm appends `host` onto the ordered upstream carrier, while `buildRequest` independently does `regular.Add` for `host` and sets `http.Request.Host` from the same empty `authority`, so an empty authority reaches **`http.Request.Host` and the access-log/tracing `Authority` field** — **NOT** the route table, whose `routeMatch` interface is `matches(path string) bool` and cannot see the request at all. Cost FLOOR **+15 / -1 production over ONE file and TWO symbols** (`buildH2Request`, `buildRequest`), measured by a prototype applied, run and reverted with `sha256sum -c` proving the restore — ⚠️ **A MEASURED PROTOTYPE IS A LOWER BOUND and this floor covers arms A and B ONLY**; NAMED under-enumeration: `(*ClientConn).RoundTrip`'s unconditional `:authority` emit, `h2ReconcileSkipKey`'s D-89-HOST SKIP of a filter-written `host` (an UNRESOLVED behavior decision), `(*chainDispatchAction).WriteH2`, arm C's reject, the H1 leg entirely, and **the H3 leg entirely UNPROBED**. ⚠️ **NO EXISTING TEST PINS THE DEFECT — CONTROLLER-VERIFIED** with a green baseline FIRST, then green WITH the prototype across `go test ./internal/... -count=1` at **69 packages ok**, the single failure going **6/6 green on retry** with the prototype still applied; the row therefore ships with ZERO inherited guard and must bring its own. ⚠️ **THE DIFFERENTIAL ARM CANNOT USE `helpers.H2RoundTrip`, PROVEN AT THE PINNED SOURCE** — `x/net@v0.34.0` `http2/transport.go:2162` SILENTLY DROPS a client-set `host` header and `:2146` ALWAYS synthesizes `:authority` from `req.Host`, so all three H/2 shapes are STRUCTURALLY INEXPRESSIBLE through it (the same class as the phase-89 PLAN's `order=` line, caught at BRAINSTORM this time); the instrument ALREADY EXISTS in-tree at `test/fixtures/0119-grpc-unary-trailers/driver/driver.go`, a full raw-framer H/2 client with an explicit hand-built pseudo-header list. Anticipated **ADR-0312** (TAIL-derived; headings+1 COLLIDES at the ADR-0209 gap) — the SPEC RE-ARMS the strict `PROPOSED` guard 0 -> 1. Anticipated counts: stat surface **406** delta **0**, fuzzers **55/48** +0, BackendKind tail **38** +0, `go.mod` +0, config fields +0, blank imports **121** +0; **fixtures 121 is NOT yet anticipated +0** — extend-`0004`-vs-mint-`0120` is a SPEC decision and `0120` STAYS UNCONSUMED. ⚠️ **THE H2-CAPABLE DOWNSTREAM FIXTURE SET IS FOUR, NOT ONE** (`0004`, `0079`, `0080`, `0119`) — the phase-89 codec census counted README prose and Go comments and was blind to the 46 of 121 fixtures that build config in their driver. `want` **121 -> 122**. |

and the proxy **fully buffers the response body** as `[]byte` at three layers, which forecloses **all** streaming and therefore full interop conformance — though **unary is provably unaffected at interop payload size**. ⚠️ **A third, previously unnamed protocol defect sat under this family and is now CLOSED by row 88 (`h2-continuation-frames`, ADR-0310):** `internal/filter/hcm/h2/conn.go`'s `dispatchFrame` (cite BY SYMBOL — the `:255-259` anchor this sentence used had already drifted to `:263-267` before the fix landed) **discarded CONTINUATION frames** behind a comment whose two clauses were both false (`ReadMetaHeaders` is assigned only in test-side peers, never in `internal/`), and `http2/6/10` sat inside the h2spec section list already reported green — ⚠️ **h2spec §6.10 passed 6/6 on the very tip that discarded every CONTINUATION frame**, which is exactly why that green never surfaced it. remaining deferred (not-yet-chartered) candidates: gRPC streaming (blocked on the buffering seam) + `grpc_http1_bridge` + `grpc_web` (both blocked on the H1-to-H2 502) + gRPC-JSON transcoding + gRPC-JSON reverse transcoding + `grpc_field_extraction` + `grpc_stats` + `connect_grpc_bridge` + the `test/conformance/grpc/` interop client declared at `BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md:350` but never created + wiring the dead `RunEncodeTrailers` hook (coupled to the WASM trailer-map seams).
